title: MeshFEM: A Block-accelerated Solver for Nonlinear Finite Elements
venue: ACM Transactions on Graphics, volume 45, issue 4, Article 121 (SIGGRAPH 2026)
abstract: MeshFEM presents a high-performance framework for nonconvex optimization problems in simulation and geometry processing. The unknowns are spatial coordinates in R^d and the objective is a sum of small-stencil element energies, so the Hessian is block sparse with dense d x d blocks. The framework accelerates the full Newton pipeline: sparsity-pattern construction, system assembly, matrix factorization, and linear solves. Its BlockCatamari solver is a block-accelerated multifrontal sparse Cholesky implementation. The paper evaluates the approach on injective surface parametrization and elasticity simulation with contact, while keeping it convenient to define new energies.
